flag: The region sizes on this record are not reliable. Its short single copy reads 3,374 bp against a set median of 17,582, and ycf1 (the gene that straddles the IR/SSC junction and is the hardest in the plastome to assemble through) is truncated to 1,412 bp against a median of 5,544. Twenty-one Arctostaphylos assemblies in this collection land on that same truncation to within one base pair and on the same short SSC to within 90 bp across 21 species, which is a signature of the assembler rather than of biology. A. bakeri subsp. bakeri falls in this group while subsp. sublaevis assembles normally. The sequence remains usable for barcoding and phylogenetics; the LSC/IR/SSC figures and the relocated-gene count do not. This assembly has been withdrawn from submission until further review. If you would like access to it, please email us.
